tradeoff: Initial output reservation is bounded by 4096 bytes, including whitespace-only, definition-only, hidden frontmatter, and parse-error inputs. Small or empty returned outputs may retain that initial capacity; visible output can still grow beyond it. The cap bounds only initial reservation, not final String capacity.
